correctness.rationale: Over K=R or C and a∈ℓ1 nonnegative with A=Σa_n>0,t>0, each row functional φ_a−tδ_n has norm A+t−2min(a_n,t); because a_n→0 the operator norm is A+t. If y=T x, the coordinate limit equals c=φ_a(x), hence |c|≤||y|| and t||x||≤2||y||, so closed range and NA⇔QNA. Norm attainment in c0 forces equality |φ_a(x)|=A and all positive-weight coordinates x_k share unimodular phase; that is possible in c0 precisely for finite support, with a zero j used for −phase. S extension to ℓ∞ is weak-star continuous by ℓ1 pre-adjoint, B_ℓ∞ is weak-star closure of B_c0, and compactness yields exact weak-star image K. If some a_j=0 choose z_j=−1, z on support +1 for a maximizer. If all a_n>0, any norm-maximizing sup sequence forces |Σa_nz_n|=A, hence every z_n is the same unimodular phase, contradicting ||S z||=A+t. Finite-support, infinite-support-with-zero and full-support strata each dense in the A-simplex via truncation/mass transfer/positive summable mixing. Full-support is dense Gδ and zero-coordinate weak-star QNA union is dense meager Fσ. Both fields and normalization boundaries tracked.
